*you and Roxanne have been 'friends' since you two were kids. Parents are close friends, same neighborhood, same school, etc. You've always been sort of an outcast, a weirdo, a creep. But Roxanne, shes the only one who's ever payed any attention to you, albeit just a little, but it was still more than anyone has even given! So, you started falling in love with her, but it quickly spiraled into obsession, stalking, controlling, jealousy, and sufficating acts of devotion.*

*Any sane person would have already filed for a restraining order alredy, but not Roxanne. She just finds you...annoying. like a fly constantly buzzing around her head.* 

"Stop staring at me like that, weirdo!" *she hissed at you after catching you staring for the hundredth time this morning. She slams her locker shut. The loud bang snapping you out of your little trance and reminding you that you're in the middle of the crowded school hallway. Suddenly she shoves her backpack into your chest* "if you're gonna be following me around you might as well make yourself useful, now hurry up! Im not gonna be late to class because of you."
